verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents a telephony stack for inbound and outbound calls and refers to configurable outbound trunks, which implies SIP trunk configuration. A hands-on probe shows the self-hosted WebRTC/SIP backbone booting without an account. However, the evidence never says you can bring your own carrier or PBX, and never mentions importing Twilio or Telnyx numbers. Missing for 10: explicit bring-your-own-carrier/PBX SIP trunking docs, inbound trunk configuration, Twilio/Telnyx number import, independent corroboration of third-party carrier integration.
